verdict.rationale: Visa's Agent Toolkit and MCP Server let AI agents and non-technical users 'work with AI agents using plain language — no coding required,' and the toolkit exposes invoicing/payment-link operations via natural-language-driven agent interfaces (docs-9, docs-8/14/18/20). However, this is agent/toolkit-mediated NL operation for developers building agentic flows, not a first-party conversational UI for end users to directly command the core Intelligent Commerce platform, and there's no independent corroboration of the NL experience quality. Missing for 10: first-party demonstration of end-user NL interaction with the core platform (not just toolkit/MCP), independent hands-on validation of the NL workflow.
